title: DMcloud: Macromolecular Structure Modeling with Local Structure Fitting for Medium to Low Resolution Cryo-EM Maps
content: Cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has become an essential method in structural biology for determining macromolecular structures. However, interpreting cryo-EM maps, especially at intermediate and low resolutions, remains challenging due to difficulties in accurately building structural models. A common approach is to fit atomic models into density maps, but this process often struggles with inaccuracies in atomic models or the high computational cost of assembling fitted structures. As a result, reconstructing macromolecular structures from cryo-EM maps remains a complex task.
